data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provisions for claims includes an improvement of GBP 3.4m in respect of reserves set in prior years (2022: deterioration of GBP 3.4m).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Commutation of the 2020 year of account into Syndicate 2791 reduced the syndicate's gross claims outstanding by GBP 7,172k in the year.
Major US Gulf hurricane impacting predominantly Florida; projected ultimate gross losses were reported for 2022 and impacted reserves/claims development for the 2022 year.

named_events.loss_description: Projected ultimate gross losses of $44.5m for the syndicate's exposure; majority of insured loss in Florida.
Made landfall in August 2023 as a category 3 near Keaton Beach, Florida where insured values were limited and the syndicate's and the industry's loss was not material.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 was GBP 59.471m. Analysis of the claims development triangle shows a modest favourable development on prior underwriting years (primarily 2021) of approximately GBP 1.735m (a ~2.9% release of opening gross claims). The report also notes a net improvement in prior years of GBP 3.4m (net of reinsurance). The movement reflects generally favourable claims development rather than major reserve strengthening, with notable items during the year including commutation/RITC activity and US hurricane activity that primarily impacted recent years.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provisions for claims includes an improvement of GBP 3.4m in respect of reserves set in prior years (2022: deterioration of GBP 3.4m).
There has been an overall surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 2.9m (2022: deficit of GBP 1.7m).
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (converted from GBP '000 to GBP m). The report frequently quotes net (after reinsurance) prior-year movements in narrative; where gross movements were not explicitly stated, the triangle was used. RITC and commutations are present in the movements and can distort simple comparisons. Some narrative figures are net of reinsurance (not used for gross PYD) and some event losses are quoted in USD without direct GBP conversion - these were left as null where GBP quantification was not provided.
